newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Malaysia, Hungary to cooperate on Bosnia - Mahathir.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia, Hungary to cooperate on Bosnia - Mahathir.

text.p: Malaysia and Hungary will cooperate in helping to repair war damage in Bosnia, Malaysian Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad said on Monday.

"Malaysia has been involved in Bosnia for quite some time and it is only natural that we would want to participate in the reconstruction," Mahathir said during a joint news conference in Hungary with Prime Minister Gyula Horn.

"At the same time...the government of Bosnia has invited us to participate in the reconstruction of Bosnia, specifically in the fields of heavy construction, communications and transportation," said Mahathir, whose country has the third largest peacekeeping force in Bosnia, after Britain and France.

"We are seriously looking into this but we think there is hope to work with Hungary because Hungary is close by and Hungary has the people with the skills and qualifications to participate in the reconstruction of Bosnia," he said on the first day of a two-day visit.
"We have been offered several projects in Bosnia but at the moment we have not concluded any new contracts," Mahathir added.

Mahathir and Horn said they had signed a cooperation agreement to link a special information technology industrial zone being built near the Malaysian capital Kuala Lumpur and a similar Infopark in Budapest.
